feed.title: Open Source Release Watch
feed.subtitle: Notable releases from the open-source ecosystem.

entry.title: Python 3.14.0 Beta 1 Released
entry.summary: The CPython development team released Python 3.14.0 beta 1, introducing experimental support for lazy imports and a new free-threading mode that removes the GIL under a build flag.

entry.title: Rust 1.84.0 Stabilises Arbitrary Self Types
entry.summary: Rust 1.84.0 ships with arbitrary self types v2 stabilised, allowing smart pointer types to be used as method receivers without the unstable feature flag.

entry.title: SQLite 3.48.0 Adds Indexed Expressions on Virtual Tables
entry.summary: SQLite 3.48.0 extends expression indexes to virtual tables and fixes a query planner edge case that caused full scans on certain LEFT JOIN patterns.

entry.title: curl 8.12.0 Defaults to HTTP/3 When Available
entry.summary: curl 8.12.0 upgrades automatically to HTTP/3 when the server advertises QUIC support via Alt-Svc, with a new --http3-only flag for strict enforcement.

entry.title: Git 2.48 Ships Reftable Storage Backend as Default
entry.summary: Git 2.48 makes the reftable reference storage backend the default for new repositories, replacing the packed-refs text file format and improving performance for repositories with large numbers of branches.

entry.title: Node.js 24.0 LTS Enters Maintenance Mode
entry.summary: Node.js 24 moved to maintenance LTS status, meaning it will receive only critical bug fixes and security patches until its end-of-life date in April 2028.
